task:
FIX REVIEW FINDINGS ON PR #833 (v3-host-storage-detail, READ-ONLY action), round 1. Work on the existing branch (target_branch). Keep the workflow-level concurrency group `chatgpt-ed-new-ops` unchanged. Address exactly these, each with tests:

1. Accurate write claims under relatime: production `/` is mounted `rw,relatime`, so directory scans can update atime metadata. Do not claim `filesystem_writes_performed=false` unqualified. Replace it with `content_writes_performed=false` plus `directory_atime_metadata_writes_possible` (true when any scanned path's mount lacks noatime/nodiratime/ro) and keep `atime_updating_mounts`. Correct docs/operations/v3-finder-production-rollout-state.md (around lines 827-832) and any other docs that say scans are refused under relatime: they now run and the receipt records that atime metadata may be updated; no file content is written.
2. Do not walk the production pgdata volume through Docker: remove every `docker system df` call (plain and -v), which makes Moby compute the size of every local volume including the ~1.3 TB PostgreSQL volume. Instead: list images with `docker image ls --format '{{json .}}'` (report their reported sizes); list volumes with `docker volume ls` + `docker volume inspect`; measure only volumes NOT mounted by a container whose name ends in `-postgres` (and never any volume whose mountpoint is the pgdata path the /var/lib scan already excludes) with `du -sx --block-size=1` on the mountpoint; report the postgres data volume(s) as `size_bytes: null, measured: false, reason: postgres_data_volume_not_scanned`. overlay2/buildkit remain covered by the existing /var/lib du (with pgdata excluded).
3. Same-device nested/bind mounts under /var/lib: before any du under /var/lib, parse /proc/self/mountinfo (octal-unescape fields) and refuse the /var/lib scan (record `var_lib_scan_refused: nested_mount` with the offending mount points; continue other read-only sections) if any mount point other than `/` lies strictly under /var/lib and is not an excluded pgdata mount, or any same-device (major:minor of `/`) entry other than `/` has a mount root under /var/lib (a bind source). Mirror the approach in the existing disk-inventory action (scripts/operator/actions/ for v3-disk-inventory). Remember the Python lives inside a single-quoted bash string: no apostrophes anywhere in it, including comments.

Run ruff, actionlint if available, and pytest on the storage-detail tests plus tests/test_v3_derived_purge_ops_workflow.py; `python scripts/operator/v3_production_deploy.py --operation authority-gate` must report failures []. Do not dispatch any workflow. Do not reply on the PR (Claude will).
